decision: Repair-5 did not produce another observer sample: every capture connection was refused and the owner retrieved a zero-row terminal from the prior remote output path. Treat this as a pre-science server-readiness and artifact-provenance failure. Retain the H200 claim and bind repair-6 to restore verified server health and a generation-fresh capture root before submitting the unchanged request batch.

capture_stderr.fact: All attempted curl connections to 127.0.0.1:30000 were refused.

mutable_scope: server process or container launch and health-check glue
remote capture-output archival and generation-specific atomic output-root creation
retrieval provenance checks that reject terminals predating the current healthy server generation
required_sequence: retrieve and preserve the failed server launch/process evidence once
archive the prior remote capture root without deleting controller evidence
restart only the mutable server or container under the same claim and repair-5 observer bytes
require a strict successful health probe, live server process identity, and H200 telemetry before capture submission
create a generation-fresh capture root and only then submit the unchanged 32-request batch once
accept capture only when its terminal provenance postdates the healthy launch and its manifest contains nonzero request-mapped tap rows

forbidden: counting the refused connections or retrieved zero-row terminal as a capture sample
another request submission before strict server health
changing prompts, checkpoint, tap layers, hidden size, observer repair-5 semantics, training, holdout, or endpoint contract
claim_disposition: Retain PID 2056931, its heartbeat, checkpoint, image, caches, and exclusive H200 claim across repair-6; the measured restart and capture path fits the remaining lifecycle.
